Priya Shah: FYI — GreenBridge onboarding showing recurring latency spikes on inference endpoints last 48h. Customer flagged this as renewal risk and asked for SLO evidence + credit calc.
Diego Morales: On it. Do you have sample windows/times? I can run a p99 rollup and check deploy history.
Priya Shah: Uploaded a short CSV with sample timestamps to the drive (link pasted in convo). Quick query I used: ```SELECT time, p99_latency_ms FROM metrics.inference WHERE customer='greenbridge' AND time > now()-48h ORDER BY time``` — p99s hit ~650ms at peaks, p95 ~250ms. Contract SLO is p99 < 500ms.
eng-oncall-bot: ALERT: latency_spike detected for namespace=customer-greenbridge service=inference | threshold p99>500ms | 2026-03-20T03:12:00Z -> 2026-03-20T04:05:00Z | incident_id=INC-6721
Morgan Lee: Context from onboarding: they went GA 10 days ago. Expectation in contract: p95 < 200ms, p99 < 500ms. They were promised improved tail latency after we enabled prefix caching. They just escalated to AM.
Diego Morales: Preliminary look shows spike aligns with 03:00-04:00 UTC window — correlates with nightly model shard rebalancer + a cache eviction event. I'll pull traces and deploy diffs.
Priya Shah: Customer is asking for a single-month credit if p99 exceeded SLA for > 72 hours cumulative across the month. Need to quantify impacted minutes and pro-rate.
Ravi Patel: Action items for evidence bundle: (1) p99 times list (CSV), (2) trace samples for 3 representative spikes, (3) deploy and config change history, (4) a short executive note summarizing cause and mitigation. Can CS/Eng confirm ETA?
Diego Morales: I'll upload traces and a short timeline by 17:00 PST. Traces will include request IDs from the CSV. I suspect cache priming bug — temporary mitigation: pin small warm cache for GreenBridge routes.
Priya Shah: Credit calc proposal (draft): ```credit = min(1.0, impacted_seconds / (30*24*3600)) * monthly_subscription_fee``` For example, 6 hours impacted -> credit = (21600/2592000) * fee ≈ 0.83% of monthly fee. We can adapt to contract language (they asked for single-week threshold though).
Morgan Lee: I'll draft the customer-facing note and include the credit example. Also add a proactive offer for a free performance runbook session with Enablement.
Ravi Patel: Please include a short remediation timeline and "what we're doing to prevent recurrence" bullets. We should also attach query and raw CSV as evidence for audit.
Priya Shah: Scheduled a quick sync with AM and GreenBridge at 16:30 PT — @Diego Morales @Morgan Lee pls join. I'll share the bundle beforehand.
Diego Morales: Ack, joining. Will bring traces + remediation plan.
Morgan Lee: Acknowledged. Draft comms ready for review after Diego uploads the artifacts. :thumbsup:
eng-oncall-bot: NOTE: automated doc attached -> /incidents/INC-6721/export.zip (contains metrics CSV, top traces, deploy diff)
